description: This file implements the EventThread class and related factory functions for managing event-driven threading, including thread creation, execution, synchronization, and cleanup within the firebolt::rialto::common namespace.

classes.name: IEventThreadFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating event thread instances.

classes.name: EventThreadFactory
classes.description: Concrete factory class for creating EventThread instances.

classes.name: EventThread
classes.description: Class managing a dedicated thread executing queued functions, with support for thread naming, synchronization, and cleanup.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IEventThreadFactory instance.

methods.name: createEventThread
methods.description: Creates a new EventThread instance with the specified thread name.

methods.name: EventThread
methods.description: Constructor initializing the EventThread with a thread name and starting the thread.

methods.name: ~EventThread
methods.description: Destructor that signals shutdown, joins the thread, and cleans up.

methods.name: threadExecutor
methods.description: Main loop executed by the thread, processing queued functions and handling thread naming.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Ensures all queued functions are executed by signaling via a semaphore.

methods.name: addImpl
methods.description: Adds a function to the queue for execution by the thread.
